label: PF Backlog 159
title: JobManager: enhanced queue (states, priority, pause/resume pairing, set_parallel, visibility)
body: core/job_manager.py ENHANCES the existing portfolio.db queue (same file/worker/run_pipeline launch; migration-safe columns). States: queued/scheduled/pause_pending/paused/running/done/failed/cancelled. Ordering on slot-free: paused-resume first, then priority, then FIFO; future-scheduled and paused-blocked skipped. resume_after pairing (paused job auto-queues when its blocker finishes). pause_request→mark_paused (safe checkpoint) / resume / cancel; run_now_on_priority (pause least-urgent running job for a priority one); set_parallel (capacity/cost warning + persist). Key ids aligned per job: job_id/run_id/item_ids/source/actor. Wired: run_entry.enqueue + queue_status, portfolio.worker_loop claims via JobManager + _jm_finish auto-queues blocked pairs, run_pipeline marks paused when asked. Verified: priority order, scheduled skip, pause→Y runs→Y done→X auto-resume, set_parallel.
